selector.rationale: The presence of oral erosions, lingual biopsy showing epidermal acanthosis and necrotic keratinocytes, and fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane, combined with the diagnosis of type AB thymoma, supports Paraneoplastic pemphigus as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Thymoma-associated immunodeficiency
rejected.why: Normal IgA and IgM levels do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Sjögren's syndrome
rejected.why: Normal liver function and negative hepatitis tests do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Graft-versus-host disease
rejected.why: No evidence of graft-versus-host disease is provided in the vignette
